about.purpose: Fixed golden set for the CDC assistant matcher (P17-37). Each question names the intent that should answer it, or null where the honest behaviour is the 'not covered' message.
about.provenance: P17-20 (audience and feedback readout) had not run when this was written and assistant_feedback held about 2 rows, so the questions are written from the lessons and from assistant.yml topics, not from real visitor data. Replace them with real questions when P17-20 lands.
about.howToUse: Run `node scripts/assistant-golden.mjs` for the report. tests/unit/assistant-golden.test.js scores the set offline against src/js/assistant-matcher.js and src/data/assistant.yml and fails if the score drops below assistant-golden-baseline.json or a question outside knownFailures fails. Do not edit assistant answers to turn a known failure green in the same change as this file; fix the matcher or the knowledge base in its own PR, then remove the question from knownFailures and raise the baseline.
about.ids: expect is an intent id from src/data/assistant.yml, or null for 'the assistant should say it has no answer'. thesis lists rule names from thesis.required that the returned answer must also satisfy. knownFailures lists question texts that fail today.
